newsitem.title: USA: Active Voice sees Q4 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Active Voice sees Q4 below expectations.

text.p: Active Voice Corp said Thursday it expects revenues and earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter ending March 31 to be below analysts' forecasts.
Revenues are expected to be up 12 to 16 percent over the year-ago quarter, while earnings should be "slightly up" from a year ago, the company said in a statement.
Active Voice cited timing and delay problems for certain orders from larger customers. It gave no details.
A year ago the company reported earnings of $668,874, or $0.14 a share, on sales of $11.0 million.
Analysts expect the company to earn $0.27 to $0.29 a share in the fourth quarter, according to First Call.
The company is to report fourth-quarter results on May 13.
